zones.message: Renderer cannot import from main. Cross the process boundary via the preload bridge (window.api / IpcChannels).
Renderer cannot import from preload directly. Preload's bindings reach the renderer through contextBridge as window.api.
Main cannot import from renderer. Renderer code is React + DOM and won't load in the main process.
Main cannot import from preload. Preload is a separate sandbox with its own entry; main composes IPC handlers and broadcasts.
Preload cannot import from main. Preload runs in a sandboxed renderer-adjacent context; it bridges via ipcRenderer.invoke against channels declared in shared/ipc.
Preload cannot import from renderer. Preload mounts before the renderer and can't depend on React code.
Shared cannot import from main. shared/ is process-agnostic and must stay reachable from both sides.
Shared cannot import from renderer. shared/ is process-agnostic and must stay reachable from both sides.
Shared cannot import from preload. shared/ is process-agnostic and must stay reachable from both sides.

patterns.message: src/shared/ is process-agnostic and must not import Node built-ins. A `node:fs` (etc.) import would crash the renderer at runtime since Chromium has no Node. Move the helper into src/main/ or src/preload/ instead.
